prod_desktop.headingText: Are you blind or visually impaired?
prod_desktop.subheadingText: TravelMate AI features an end-to-end hands-free voice engine. Say “Yes” into your microphone or tap below to enable spoken audio guides, automatic route readouts, and voice emergency triggers.
prod_desktop.bodySnippet:
Accessible Voice Gate · Press Alt+B anytime
Are you blind or visually impaired?

TravelMate AI features an end-to-end hands-free voice engine. Say “Yes” into your microphone or tap below to enable spoken audio guides, automatic route readouts, and voice emergency triggers.

Microphone standby

Say "Yes" or "No", or use the buttons below

YES - Enable Voice Mode
NO - Standard Mode
Replay Audio Prompt
Press Tab to navigate · Esc to dismiss

Emergency location setup

Allow location before using TravelMate

When you later tap WhatsApp or SMS in Safety Mode, TravelMate will refresh your GPS location and place it in the emergency message automatically.

What is stored

Only the latest coordinates, accuracy and capture time are stored locally in this browser. They are not sent to TravelMate servers.

WhatsApp and SMS will open with a prepared message. Your phone still requires you to review it and tap Send; a website cannot silently send messages on your behalf.
Allow and continue
